image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront with a brick facade. The shop features a large display window filled with baked goods on shelves, illuminated by warm interior lighting. A blue sign with white text runs above the window. To the right is a glass door entrance. The lower facade includes green painted panels and a small step.
